title: Do not confuse a recycled PID with the mission background worker
objective: Find the path that decides whether a background mission worker is still alive. A recycled PID that now belongs to an unrelated process must not be reported as the mission worker. Preserve the current result for a live matching worker and define a conservative result for legacy status records that lack identity metadata. Add deterministic tests using mocked or injected process metadata rather than real long-running processes.
acceptance_criteria: A live PID with matching persisted identity is reported as running.
A live PID with mismatched identity is reported as stale or stopped.
A missing PID is reported as stopped.
Legacy records without identity metadata follow an explicitly tested conservative policy.
Tests do not launch or sleep on real background workers.

operator_verification.additional_acceptance: Injected process metadata distinguishes a matching worker from a recycled PID and treats identity-less legacy records conservatively.
